output.summary: On the inflation evidence, every signal points the same way: hawkish. The deterministic pre-read puts the 12-month anchor at 3.008 versus a 2.0 goal (gap_pp 1.008), with the nowcast gap wider at 1.113 and momentum still above goal (3m 2.046, 6m 2.744). The committee's projections show end-2026 PCE inflation at 3.7 and the 2026 funds-rate median revised up from 3.8 to 4.1 (revision_pp 0.3). Both the September and October statements say \"Inflation remains elevated\" and frame policy around returning inflation to 2 percent, and two members dissented in October preferring a 1/4-point hike. Nothing in the inflation evidence argues for a cut. Net tilt is moderately hawkish at +6 bp, short of maximum because the October committee itself chose to hold rather than hike.
